definitions.gloss: the first train of the day
definitions.explanation: the earliest train service on a particular route or line

examples.japanese: {始発電車|しはつでんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I took the first train to head to the airport.
The first train leaves at 5 o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧{始発電車|しはつでんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I missed the last train and waited for the first train.

notes:
TRANSPORTATION VOCABULARY:
{始発電車|しはつでんしゃ} refers to the first train of the day on a particular line or route.

FORMS:
Often shortened to ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧.

TYPICAL TIMES:
{始発電車|しはつでんしゃ} usually runs between 4:30-5:30 AM depending on the line.

WHO USES IT:
- Early morning workers
- Travelers heading to airports
- People who missed the last train and waited overnight
- Early risers wanting to avoid crowds

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {始発電車|しはつでんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ - to catch the first train
- {始発電車|しはつでんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ - to wait for the first train
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ - to go home on the first train (after staying out all night)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧ - last train
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧ - first train (short form); first departure
- ⟦{通勤電車|つうきんでんしゃ}→通勤電車：08568_tsuukindensha⟧ - commuter train
- ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧ - early morning
